{{Quote|The belters are mining the asteroid fields at the edge of the system.|[[High Magistrate]] [[Greef Karga]] to [[Din Djarin]]|<ref name="Chapter 17">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 17: The Apostate}}</ref>}}
'''Asteroid fields''' were located at the edge of [[Nevarro system|Nevarro's system]]. The fields were mined by by [[belters]], and the money made from mining them helped [[Nevarro City]] on the [[planet]] [[Nevarro]] to prosper.<ref name="Chapter 17" />

After [[Din Djarin]] shot [[pirate]]s from [[Gorian Shard's pirate crew|Gorian Shard's pirate gang]] on Nevarro, the gang [[Dogfight in the Nevarro system|ambushed]] him at the asteroid fields. Djarin was able to destroy several of the pirates' [[Cumulus-class snub fighter|fighters]], until he was led to [[Gorian Shard's pirate Corsair|Gorian Shard's Corsair]], and escaped.<ref name="Chapter 17" />
